name: stress-ng getrandom
description: Start N workers that get 8192 random bytes from the /dev/urandom pool using the getrandom system call (Linux) or getentropy (OpenBSD). The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
